name: Ou Ma
title: Professor; Alan B. Shepard Chair; Director, Intelligent Robotics and Autonomous Systems Laboratory
fitReason: Direct PPO and generative domain adaptation for executed service-robot manipulation, with a broader autonomous-robot control program.

physicalEvidence.summary: February 2025 primary preprint executes a Gazebo-trained PPO policy on a differential-drive electric-wheelchair base modified with a two-DOF assistive lever and side bar. VAE camera/force representations and CycleGAN real-to-simulation images support pulling actual self-closing office doors. Hardware results are 17/20 successes across two doors; the 95% headline is simulation. Left-hinged transfer uses mirrored observations/actions and a newly trained CycleGAN. Door approach and unlatching are separate perception/force-guided components. The paper’s IRAS affiliation plus an independent UC report naming lead author Yufeng Sun in Ma’s lab establish current-host project linkage. March 2026 dual-arm satellite work is simulation, not additional physical deployment.

shortVisit.summary: No applicable external-master short-visit invitation found on the official faculty or laboratory pages. University-level internship/scholar procedures are separate from an IRAS offer.

scoreReasons.fit: Substantive deep RL and generative sim-to-real adaptation in robot manipulation.
scoreReasons.physical: Real mobile door manipulation with independent current UC directed-group linkage.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No lab-level invitation applicable to external master’s short research visits.
scoreReasons.freshness: Detailed 2025 physical manuscript, current 2026 official research activity and faculty record.

name: Kira Barton
title: Professor of Robotics and Mechanical Engineering; Barton Research Group
fitReason: Verified learned grasp scoring on a physical manipulator and current graph-neural multi-robot RL research; manufacturing control is the application context.

physicalEvidence.summary: GraspMixer (IEEE T-ASE 2025) uses an MLP-Mixer grasp-quality classifier trained on synthetic data alongside analytical contact-pair generation. Real KUKA KMR iiwa 7/Weiss gripper trials use an Azure Kinect, 14 printed objects and 126 attempts. Complete object CAD geometry is assumed; classical HSV/ICP pose estimation is manually checked and MoveIt executes the selected grasp. This is learned grasp scoring coupled to control, not end-to-end learned perception. The author’s repository attributes the project to Michigan’s Barton Research Group, but his Michigan work predates his current Purdue appointment; current availability of that exact setup is unverified. September 2026 GNN-RL cooperative table lifting is Isaac Gym only. Current SMART 4.0 hardware is independently documented without assuming that the new neural method has executed there.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master short-visitor invitation verified from official faculty/lab pages. Historical visitor rosters and degree recruitment do not establish a summer 2027 place.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct learned robot manipulation and current GNN-RL; broader program includes substantial manufacturing/control work.
scoreReasons.physical: Actual GraspMixer KUKA execution with author-verified Michigan group ownership; conservative cap for earlier member’s project and unverified current setup access.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No applicable lab-level external-master short-visit invitation.
